title: The utilization level of medical resources, health capital and financial asset allocation of middle-aged and elderly households
core_idea: This study examines how the utilization level of medical resources and household health capital relate to the financial asset allocation decisions of middle-aged and elderly households, exploring underlying mechanisms and heterogeneous effects using CHARLS 2015 and 2018 data and econometric models.
tldr: Using CHARLS 2015 and 2018 and logit, tobit, and mediating-effect models, the paper investigates links between medical resource utilization, health capital, and financial asset allocation among middle-aged and elderly households to inform policies on health and aging finance.
